context: Ryosuke congratulates Sakura on her book release.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: さくら、本、おめでとう、本当に。
lines.en: Sakura — congratulations. I really mean it.
lines.style: Warm, unhurried opening. Soft genuine smile audible in the voice. Gentle emphasis on her name, then steady tender conviction through the close.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.style: Quiet intensity beneath softness. Slow pace, each word weighted. A small catch in the voice on gratitude, steadying. Eye contact held.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 小さい頃から、夢、追ってきた。
lines.en: You've been chasing this dream since you were small.
lines.style: Reminiscing warmth. Gentle, almost wondering tone — watching the memory unfold as he speaks. Slight lift of admiration mid-sentence.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 皆の応援、本当に、ありがとう。
lines.en: I couldn't have done this without everyone's support. Thank you.
lines.style: Sincere and grounded. No performance. Direct eye contact in the delivery. A pause before the thanks — letting the weight of it land.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.en: We're all proud of you. All of us.
lines.style: Steady, certain. Soft firmness on 'all' — making sure she hears it. The voice drops slightly, intimate. Real weight behind the words.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.en: Our family means everything to me. Really.
lines.style: Tender vulnerability. Slower pace. The 'really' isn't emphasis — it's honesty breaking through. Slight thickness in the voice.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.en: Keep going. I believe in you.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Gentle but not soft. A father's promise resting under the words. Steady, warm close with no flourish.
